items.name: Kalmar Cubing 2026
items.information: Välkomna till Kalmar Cubing 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Kalmar Cubing 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: New York Multimate PBQ IV 2026
items.information: This competition only has blind events and Fewest Moves. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [other competitions in New York](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=New+York&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). ____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
